correctness.rationale: The exact two-variable torus orthogonality computation gives M=58+2(|L_A|²+|L_B|²)+8Re(L_A conj(L_B)+exp(i(v-t))). Substitution yields M-50=8[2(z0+xy)²+x²(1-y²)+y²(1-x²)], nonnegative for every angle. Solving all zero terms produces precisely three normalized minimizers. Bounding each aperiodic autocorrelation by its overlap count gives upper endpoint 19*6=114, and horizontal/vertical shift equality forces all character phases. Haar no-alias condition is explicit; q-alphabet counts use unique normalization. checker.py independently passed exhaustive exact Gaussian-integer checks for q=2,4 and finite Fourier comparisons; finite tests do not replace the analytic proof.

value.rationale: The full 3x2 Cartesian frequency rectangle is the smallest nontrivial dense two-dimensional aperture joining long horizontal and vertical correlation constraints. Full aperiodic ISL/merit factor is a natural code-design invariant: the exact optimum 14, merit 18/7, 3 distinct continuous-phase minimizer orbits, sharp parity of q-phase attainability and the upper extremizer geometry supply meaningful structural classification. Not merely a numerical sample, renaming or a routine calculation on an arbitrary slice; it explains phase cancellation across interacting correlations and has a complete proof. No larger-array theorem is claimed.
